summary: Manage your cops, investigate crimes, and survive a gritty noir strategy sim!
description: 🏔️ Interpret the law as you see fit in This Is the Police 2, set in a cold and harsh border town where no one is completely innocent. Make tough decisions, manage your sheriff's department, and try to keep out of prison yourself in this acclaimed story-driven mixture of adventure, strategy, and turn-based tactical combat! ⛓️ 🕵️‍♂️ DIVE INTO A GRITTY, STORY-DRIVEN EXPERIENCE Smugglers, gangs, and screaming populists call Sharpwood their home. As young sheriff Lilly Reed, you must team up with fugitive criminal Jack Boyd. Navigate a mature, branching narrative where every choice has harsh consequences. Maintain order, and pray your dangerous plan doesn’t spiral out of control. 🚔 TAKE CHARGE OF YOUR DEPARTMENT Your subordinates aren’t just resources—they are living people with their own strengths, weaknesses, fears, and prejudices. Balance a cop who drinks too much with one who refuses to follow orders. You’ll have to show a steady hand and adapt to their personalities if you want to impose discipline and survive. 🎯 ENGAGE IN TACTICAL COMBAT When operations get dangerous, gather your finest cops and switch to tense, turn-based combat. Carefully study the terrain, approach suspects stealthily, and use non-lethal equipment if the situation allows. Beware: there are no hit points here. A single bullet can cost a cop their life, meaning every tactical move matters. 🔎 BECOME A TRUE DETECTIVE Collect evidence, study case materials, connect the dots, and interrogate suspects to send criminals to court. And if the suspect was innocent? Perhaps it's time to find out if any Sharpwood judges can be bought. KEY FEATURES: Deep Management: Balance the daily lives, flaws, and schedules of a unique roster of cops. Tactical Combat: Command your squad in high-stakes, turn-based shootouts. Investigative Detective Work: Gather clues and interrogate suspects to solve crimes. Rich Noir Narrative: Experience a dark, atmospheric story where your morality is tested. Premium Experience: Play entirely without ads and enjoy full tablet support! Supported languages: EN, ZH-CN, FR, DE, IT, JA, KO, PL, PT, RU, ES Thank you for playing ‘THIS IS THE POLICE 2’! © 2026 THQ Nordic Mobile
